data.name: Instructions
data.value: 1. Keep the teacher console open on this LAN and unlock its lab key before installing any PCs. 2. On each student PC, run {0} as an administrator. 3. Select this PC's number. Creating the student account and enabling automatic sign-in is selected by default. Clear that checkbox if you want to use the PC's existing accounts instead. 4. Complete installation and restart Windows to apply the PC name and power settings. 5. In the teacher console, verify that this PC appears green and connected.
